description: This file defines a PHP class 'CalendarViewGetGR' that extends 'SugarView' and provides functionality to process and display some JSON configuration data related to calendar views in the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: CalendarViewGetGR
classes.description: A controller class extending SugarView that handles view processing and displaying JSON configuration data tailored for calendar view functionalities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
